definitions.explanation: A door or entrance at the back of a building, as opposed to the main entrance.
Figuratively, an unofficial or illegitimate way of achieving something, often implying bribery or unfair advantage.

examples.japanese: {裏口|うらぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter through the back door.

examples.japanese: {裏口|うらぐち}⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Backdoor admissions have become a problem.
examples.notes: Refers to gaining admission through bribery or connections

examples.japanese: ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉|し}まっていた→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧{裏口|うらぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The front entrance was closed, so I used the back door.

examples.japanese: {裏口|うらぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}び→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I carried the luggage in through the back door.
Getting work through backdoor connections is not good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏口|うらぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that he entered the world of politics through the back door.

notes:
USAGE: {裏口|うらぐち} has both literal and figurative meanings.

LITERAL:
- {裏口|うらぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to enter from the back)
- {裏口|うらぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ (to open the back door)

FIGURATIVE (illicit means):
- {裏口|うらぐち}⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧ (backdoor admission - through bribery/connections)
- {裏口|うらぐち}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (illicit business)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表口|おもてぐち}→表口：07880_omoteguchi⟧/⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧ - front entrance
- ⟦{勝手口|かってぐち}→勝手口：19491_katteguchi⟧ - kitchen entrance, service entrance
